name: Lycaon Data
positioning: Custom econometric reports and a SaaS dashboard that price a property's value drivers and market trajectory for real estate investors.
description: Lycaon Data produces econometric analysis of real estate markets: custom reports built on deduplicated listing and transaction databases, modelling how individual property attributes affect value, and quantifying supply-demand gaps by quarter. It also runs a SaaS dashboard version of the same modelling.
real_estate_use: An investment fund or developer evaluating a site asks Lycaon Data for a report on how specific attributes (surface, floor, exposure, local supply-demand balance) move price in that submarket, rather than relying on a generalist comparables tool. A bank or agency network uses the recurring dashboard to track the same supply-demand gap over time instead of commissioning a report each quarter.
features: SaaS dashboard version of the models

use_cases.job: Get a data-backed read on which property attributes drive value in a specific submarket before underwriting a deal
Quantify the local supply-demand gap for a planned development
